scientific_integrity: Analytical argument, independently structured exact coefficient checks, and finite integer-moment calculations are provided. Numerical or symbolic finite checks are not represented as an infinite proof. Literature comparison does not establish priority or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies only to an unweighted finite path with a single nonzero real on-site potential. It does not address multiple markings, arbitrary couplings, state transfer, or finite-time convergence. A more general unlocated theorem might subsume the result.
title: Arithmetic rank law for quantum average mixing on paths with a single marked site
